subject: prd/argus-boundary-enforcement
statement: Argus shall supply its problem slug on every drive-authored Git commit in the configured Pyxis workflow. When that slug reaches the `prepare-commit-msg` hook, the hook shall append `Argus-Drive: <slug>` and a content binding for the commit's tree and parent; when feature-draft preparation rebases an already stamped commit, it shall verify the original binding and refresh only a valid one without stamping an unstamped source commit. At CI, the attribution gate shall re-derive the binding from Git without a mutable platform badge or ambient credential. This is an audit signal in the single-user shared-account workflow; it does not assert that an agent with raw Git access cannot omit or forge the signal.
rationale: Preserves verifiable attribution for ordinary drive commits and draft rounds while stating the shared-account limit and relying on exact-head operator review for merge
fit_criterion: a real hook-produced drive commit and its rebased draft version derive as Argus; a stale or replayed binding is refused before rebase and underivable at the gate; a source unstamped commit remains unstamped; CI reads only in-tree Git metadata without a credential
